output_list.function_name: function token(uint256 initialSupply, string tokenName, uint8 decimalUnits, string tokenSymbol)
output_list.reason: Although decimals have been set to 8, the base token is issued with no decimals, which makes this a very cheap token that can quickly devalue quickly. The base token is issued regardless whether the owner token supply < totalSupply. Also when others claim token, they could issue more than available, which would make the tokens devalue quicker.
